plugins.name: Text Statistics
plugins.description: Live counts for the current tab in a side panel, and word frequencies as CSV. A sample plugin in Python.
plugins.author: Ettin Edit

plugins.name: Markdown Outline
plugins.description: A clickable outline of Markdown headings, plus Insert UUID and Wrap Lines. A sample plugin in JavaScript.
plugins.author: Ettin Edit

plugins.name: HL7 Viewer
plugins.description: Browse HL7 v2 messages as a tree of segments, fields and components, inspect any field (name, data type, optionality, repeatability) and change its value. Open sample.hl7 to try it. A sample plugin in Python.
plugins.author: Ettin Edit

plugins.name: Markdown Preview
plugins.description: A live preview of the Markdown tab you are editing, with images, in a side panel that updates as you type and scrolls along with the text. A sample plugin in Python.
plugins.author: Ettin Edit
